contract: Shared PCM16 quantization contract for f32 samples: packages/dictation/src/audio.ts is the semantic source, apps/desktop-gpui/crates/dictation/src/audio.rs must match it byte for byte (issue G07). Rule: non-finite becomes 0, clamp to -1..=1, negatives scale by 0x8000 and non-negatives by 0x7fff (multiply in f64), then round with ECMAScript Math.round semantics - ties toward positive infinity, NOT f64::round's ties away from zero. All finite inputs are exactly f32-representable; non-finite inputs are spelled as strings because JSON cannot carry them. 'expected' is the i16 the encoder writes. The negative half-tie cases (e.g. -2^-16 scaling to exactly -0.5 -> 0) fail under a round-half-away-from-zero implementation, so this fixture rejects that divergence.

cases.note: signed zero: -0 < 0 is false, so the *0x7fff branch; Math.round(-0) is -0 -> 0
Number.isFinite replaces any non-finite input with 0 before clamping
same: non-finite becomes 0, never the clamp boundary
2^-16 * 0x7fff = 0.4999847412109375 -> 0; an exact +0.5 product is unreachable for the 0x7fff scale from f32 inputs
the G07 case: -2^-16 * 0x8000 = -0.5 exactly; Math.round -> 0, f64::round gave -1
negative half tie at the clip boundary: (1 - 2^-16) * 0x8000 = -32767.5 -> -32767 (half-away-from-zero gave -32768)
